product.name: PromiseProof
product.descriptor: Deterministic verification of an activity-based personalization promise.

canonicalPromise: When personalization is OFF, no identifiable activity reaches recommendations, contextual recommendations remain functional, and the preference survives reload. When ON, expected activity reaches recommendations and behavioral recommendations remain functional.

initialHypotheses.statement: Activity collection begins before the saved preference is hydrated.
The backend preference is not retained after an OFF update.

investigation.label: Recorded authentic GPT-5.6 run
investigation.replayExpectation: The replay checks whether collection begins before preference hydration.
